up: Retrieve distinct molecule_chembl_id (as chembl_id), compound_name, and canonical_smiles for compounds referenced in document CHEMBL4376833. Join compound_records with docs on doc_id to filter by chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4376833'. Only include molecules where canonical_smiles is not null. Order the results by molecule_chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, cr.compound_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4376833' AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.chembl_id, cr.compound_name, cs.canonical_smiles
